segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "hardware" when I talk about my computer project. I say "device" when I talk about my computer project. I say "monitor" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use hardware, device, and monitor. At the end, I say: I can use hardware clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“电脑硬件与设备”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。hardware：硬件，电脑中可以实际触摸到的部件。示例：I learned how to use "hardware" in a computer task.device：设备，用来完成某项工作的电子工具。示例：I learned how to use "device" in a computer task.monitor：显示器，用来显示电脑画面。示例：I learned how to use "monitor" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“仓库与 README”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。repository：仓库，集中存放项目代码和历史记录的地方。示例：Our team uses "repository" to keep the project clear.README file：README 文件，介绍项目用途和使用方法的说明文件。示例：Our team uses "read me file" to keep the project clear.source code：源代码，程序员编写的程序文本。示例：Our team uses "source code" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
